entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: A panther warrior planeswalker and one of Urza's Nine Titans who despises the destructive power of artifice and bound his soul to Urborg.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Windgrace's home, which he vowed to always watch over.

events.summary: Windgrace sacrifices his life to protect Urborg, first binding his soul to the land and vowing to watch over it.
events.quote: He sacrificed his life to protect his home of Urborg, but not before binding his soul to the land and vowing to always watch over it.

relations.quote: one of Urza’s Nine Titans united against Phyrexia
